summary: Assessed whether PortalSifast can support adding another module. Reviewed codebase scale (~115 controllers, ~90 models, multi-domain pages) and existing modular patterns (domain controllers/services, nav group builders, TUTORIAL-TAMBAH-FITUR-BARU.md). Verdict: yes—the modular monolith is already proven across Ticketing, Aset, Inventaris, Simmutu, Tata Naskah, Web Official, etc.; main cautions are growing web.php routes, uneven policies, and keeping domain boundaries clean with tests.
current_status: PortalSifast is a mature Laravel 12 + Inertia 2 multi-module portal ready for additional modules following existing conventions; awaiting user to name the next module if they want a scoped feasibility check.
